resources.string: To understand your photos, Khojo can send a small, resized copy to our secure server. It is used only to build the search and is deleted within 24 hours. Your original photos never leave your phone.
You can change this later. If you say no, cloud AI stays off.
Find any photo by describing it
Type or say what is in the photo, like \"red saree with gold border\", and Khojo finds it.
Works in Hindi, English and Hinglish
Search the way you talk. No need to remember file names or dates.
Khojo only reads the photos you choose. Cloud AI stays off until you allow it.
